text: BAM share rose 0.03 percentage points over 26 hours and 0.22 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 34.5% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee is the largest node at 21.7% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The latest top-node handoff reads as whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover.
